event: Red Warning: Extremely Heavy Rainfall & Urban Flash Flooding
headline: Red Alert: Severe Inundation in Mumbai Suburban and Thane low-lying sectors
description: Rainfall exceeding 150mm recorded in 3 hours coinciding with a 4.5m high astronomical tide at 13:40 hrs. Severe waterlogging at Hindmata, Kurla, Milan Subway, and Thane Ghodbunder corridor.
instruction: Citizens are strictly advised to remain indoors. Avoid driving into submerged underpasses. Fishermen advised not to venture into sea.
